capabilities: Generate a changelog note listing recently edited notes
Update automatically on note creation, modification, rename, or deletion
Format entries as wiki-links or plain titles with a configurable datetime format
Prepend an optional heading and cap tracked files up to 500
disambiguation: Not a version-history tool; the changelog note is overwritten in full on each update rather than keeping a historical record.
extras: In maintenance mode: bug fixes and user-requested changes only, no new features. Originally created by Badr Bouslikhin and now maintained by someone else. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; older versions install 1.8.0. States it reads only note names, paths, and modification times, makes no network requests, and collects nothing. Includes detailed troubleshooting for install/update failures on Windows.
problem: Obsidian tracks file changes internally but offers no persistent note that lists recently created, modified, renamed, or deleted notes.

relations.evidence: Bases — built-in Obsidian feature for querying and displaying vault data
Recent Files — sidebar pane of recently opened files
List Modified — links modified files to daily, weekly, or monthly notes
Dataview — dynamic query: TABLE dateformat(file.mtime, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm") SORT file.mtime DESC LIMIT 25

summary: Changelog generator that writes a Markdown note listing recently edited notes, updated manually or automatically on vault file changes.
